name: Defensive 5-3-2

slots.why: Distributes safely and quickly to the forwards after a save.
Wide centre-back who defends the channel. Cover is the alternate.
Central defender in the middle of the three. Cover is the alternate, but only one Cover can be used.
Ball-playing defender is the one who can start an attack with a pass when the ball is won.
Support wing-back gives width but stays back as the fifth defender.
Support wing-back on the right, doing the same job as on the left.
Defensive central midfielder protects the box.
Ball-winning midfielder breaks up play in the centre and wins the ball back.
Defensive central midfielder on the other side.
Deep-lying forward (or Complete Forward) holds the ball to relieve pressure.
Advanced Forward runs in behind on the counter. Poacher is the alternate.

description: A deep five-defender system prioritising central protection and counter-attacking through two forwards.
whyGood: It packs the box while still keeping two outlets available after regains.
whyThisShape: Five defenders (three centre-backs with two wing-backs), three central midfielders and two forwards. It packs the box and the middle, and keeps two forwards as an outlet to relieve pressure and counter.
whenToUse: Protecting a lead, or against stronger opponents who will have most of the ball. It suits aerially strong centre-backs and wing-backs with plenty of stamina.
whenNotToUse: When you need to control the ball or score: the shape is built to absorb pressure.

instructionRationale.Much Lower Line of Engagement: Waits deep and defends the box instead of pressing.
instructionRationale.Much Deeper Defensive Line: Keeps the defence deep to remove space in behind.
instructionRationale.Narrower: Compresses the middle so the opponent is pushed wide.
instructionRationale.Counter: The two forwards are an outlet: the team attacks quickly when it wins the ball.
instructionRationale.Regroup: Drops back into shape after losing the ball.
